name: Shirai Rokubee
source:
What he calls the protagonist: Ryouta

[url=/c38571]Ryouta's[/url] best friend and classmate. He is also friends with his sisters. He is very passionate about his hobby, watching gravure idol videos, which he can talk a lot about. Even though he often teases Ryouta, Rokubee is a reliable friend who is always ready to help his bro out.
